description: This file declares classes related to media pipeline capabilities within the Rialto client, including a factory class for creating media pipeline capabilities instances and the main MediaPipelineCapabilities class that provides methods to query supported MIME types and check MIME type support.

classes.name: MediaPipelineCapabilitiesFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of IMediaPipelineCapabilities.

classes.name: MediaPipelineCapabilities
classes.description: Implements IMediaPipelineCapabilities to provide media pipeline capabilities, including supported MIME types and MIME type support checks.

methods.name: createMediaPipelineCapabilities
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of IMediaPipelineCapabilities.

methods.name: getSupportedMimeTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of MIME types supported for a given media source type.

methods.name: isMimeTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a specific MIME type is supported.
